# Service accounts API

5 endpoints. Request and response schemas are described on the [schemas page](schemas.md); the other tags are listed in the [API index](README.md).

## Endpoints

### `GET /api/v1/service-accounts`

List service accounts

List service accounts, by name (admin only).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | query | integer | no | Minimum: 1. |
| `per_page` | query | integer | no | Minimum: 1. Maximum: 200. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Service accounts | `application/json`: object |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |

Fields of the `200` response (`application/json`):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | array of [ServiceAccount](schemas.md#serviceaccount) | no | - |
| `page` | integer | no | - |
| `per_page` | integer | no | - |
| `total` | integer | no | - |

### `POST /api/v1/service-accounts`

Create service account

Create a service account: a named non-human principal for automation (admin only). It can hold project roles, group memberships and permission assignments like a user, and own API tokens through `/api/v1/users/{id}/tokens`, but it cannot sign in.

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: object

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `description` | string | no | Maximum length: 255. |
| `disabled` | boolean | no | - |
| `name` | string | yes | 3-64 letters, digits, dash or underscore; unique among users and service accounts; cannot be changed. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | Service account created | `application/json`: [ServiceAccount](schemas.md#serviceaccount) |
| `400` | Invalid request | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |
| `409` | A user or service account with this name exists | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |

### `PATCH /api/v1/service-accounts/{id}`

Update service account

Change the description or disable or re-enable a service account (admin only). A disabled account's tokens, including those already issued, authenticate nothing.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes | - |

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: object

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `description` | string | no | Maximum length: 255. |
| `disabled` | boolean | no | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Service account updated | `application/json`: [ServiceAccount](schemas.md#serviceaccount) |
| `400` | Invalid request | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |
| `404` | Service account not found | - |

### `DELETE /api/v1/service-accounts/{id}`

Delete service account

Delete a service account with its tokens, group memberships, project roles, permission assignments and trust policies (admin only).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `204` | Service account deleted | - |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |
| `404` | Service account not found | - |
